prompt: Fixed camera. From the first moment the dealer purses his lips, glances down at the gavel picture as if weighing it, then back up to the camera, and with an apologetic shrug of his free hand says, deadpan, in an English accent: "The courts. Slightly used." Lips move clearly and in sync, the line spoken once. He then raises his eyebrows and holds still. The frame, the gavel image and the tag text stay the same and readable. A few raindrops run off the gazebo frame above him; the figures with umbrellas in the background barely move. Sound: his line, gentle rain, a quiet murmur of a crowd. Real, damp English daylight.
